title: Harden independent release foundation phase plans
summary: Hardened the 2026.06.04.001 release-foundation planning pack so each phase can be assigned independently with explicit prerequisites, stop conditions, validation evidence, rollback notes, change-ledger expectations, and review-corrected version/package validation gates.
reason: The phase plans were reviewed as independent implementation handoffs. Package build, package/open/close validation, real-media pilot, finalization, and release-identity phases needed stronger same-candidate gates, source-safety evidence, runtime-state checks, and product-version compatibility guidance before they were safe to hand to separate agents.
behavior_before: The planning pack described sequential release phases but left some prerequisites implicit, deferred package/open/close validation from the candidate-build phase, and did not fully spell out pre-launch source-safety, scratch-copy, subtitle/OCR, or post-finalization validation expectations.
behavior_after: The planning pack now states that phases are independently assignable, requires agents to stop on missing or stale prerequisite evidence, preserves backend 2026.06.04.001 product-version contracts while using 2026.06.04.001 for release labels, marks Phase 4 as build-only until Phase 5 passes for the same candidate, requires Tauri build-check evidence before packaging, moves strict coverage back to the source checkout for package validation, requires Phase 5 runtime-state externalization evidence, requires Phase 6 same-candidate package/runtime evidence plus source-safety and subtitle proof, and requires Phase 7 post-finalization validation with an explicit rebuild rule if finalized metadata must ship in the package.
